verdict.rationale: Cursor's own marketing and docs directly claim this exact capability (Launch fleets of agents that work in parallel on ambitious tasks for hours or days), backed by extensive supporting documentation on Cloud Agents (parallel VM-isolated agents, no local machine needed), the Cloud Agents API/OpenAPI spec for programmatic fleet orchestration, worktrees for conflict-free parallel tasks, subagents for simultaneous delegation, and Automations for scheduled/always-on agents, with live probes confirming the API endpoints actually exist and are key-gated as documented. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence outside vendor docs of agents actually running successfully in parallel for multi-hour/multi-day spans at scale.
